job.title: Staff SW Engineer - Front-End / UI
job.workplace: At least 3 days a week in office
job.pay_full: $141,100 – $226,000 a year estimated salary range (may include potential sales incentive payments, if applicable); may be eligible for bonus and equity

details.about: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, operating in more than 200 countries and territories. This Staff Software Engineer is a hands-on front-end technical leader, spending about 60–75% of the time coding: building reusable UI components, improving performance and setting scalable patterns, while working with UX/UI designers, product managers, back-end engineers and QA on fintech products.
duties: Design and build responsive, accessible, performant, secure and scalable web UIs and front-end applications
Lead front-end architecture: components, application structure, state management, API integration and performance
Turn user journeys, wireframes and prototypes into polished experiences with designers and product managers
Build reusable UI components, shared libraries and design-system patterns
Lead design and code reviews and mentor engineers on architecture, accessibility, performance and testing
Diagnose complex front-end issues across browsers, rendering, state and APIs
Improve front-end testing (unit, component, integration, accessibility, end-to-end) and developer tooling
Define API contracts and integration patterns with back-end and platform teams
Take part in incident response and on-call as needed
needs: 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years with an advanced degree, or 0 years with a PhD, or 8+ years of relevant work experience
Software engineering experience focused on front-end or UI development
Hands-on modern web development in JavaScript/TypeScript with a framework such as React, Angular or Vue
HTML, CSS, modern browser technologies and responsive web development
Reusable, component-based UIs for production; RESTful API integration
Front-end testing practices and frameworks; debugging and performance optimization
Collaboration with UX/UI, product, back-end and QA; leading design and code reviews
nice: 6+ years with a Bachelor's degree, 4+ years with an advanced degree, or up to 3 years with a PhD
Large-scale front-end architectures, design systems and shared component libraries
High-volume customer-facing products, ideally in payments or financial services
details.benefits: Estimated U.S. salary range $141,100 – $226,000 a year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable); the role may also be eligible for bonus and equity. Visa's benefits package, for which this position may be eligible, includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, life insurance, paid time off and a wellness program.
notes: At least 3 days a week in the office
